DIAGNOSIS READY: Extrahepatic Cholestasis due to Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma obstructing the common bile duct.

The patient's history of significant smoking, age, and classic cholestatic symptoms (pale stools, dark urine, pruritus, weight loss) strongly suggest a malignancy of the pancreas or head of the pancreas compressing the biliary tree.
